mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 7.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic demand that increases corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) produces positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100 for 3 consecutive months), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate margins expand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO 3-mo avg > 100, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) falls below 2.0%, it signals a disinflationary environment that reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.3% month-over-month for 3 months), job market strength supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.3% (3-mo avg), or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) above 1.0% signals robust economic expansion that increases corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
